name: CaseComboboxPopoverOverlayInset
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "combobox-popover-overlay-inset" (combobox). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: the OPEN listbox as an out-of-flow overlay - `position: absolute; top: 34px` under a `position: relative` trigger, so the popover does not participate in the trigger's flow
